Kung Fu Boy Volume 17 功夫旋風兒 (Tong Li Comics, Traditional Chinese Edition)
📚 Item Details:
Title: 功夫旋風兒 (Kung Fu Boy)
Volume: 17
Author: 蛭田達也 (Tatsuya Hiruta)
Publisher: 東立出版社 (Tong Li Comics)
Language: Traditional Chinese
ISBN: 957-34-0173-8
Format: Paperback
Price printed on back: NT$60 / HK$25 / US$3
Condition: Very Good — minimal wear, bright cover colors, no major creases or tears. Binding is solid and pages are clean.
Edition: Official licensed Chinese edition (正式授權中文版)
🖼️ Description:
This is Volume 17 of Kung Fu Boy (功夫旋風兒), a popular martial arts manga written and illustrated by Tatsuya Hiruta (蛭田達也). Published by Tong Li Comics (東立出版社) in Taiwan, this traditional Chinese edition captures the energy and humor of the original Japanese release.
This particular volume features the main character rocking out on an electric guitar, showcasing the manga’s signature blend of comedy and action.
